source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: SetOperation ORs the new bit into existing operation state. SetSourceFolderURI also sets kMoveResult; keyword add/remove methods set their respective bits; AddMessageCopyOperation sets kMsgCopy and appends a separate copy destination. The current interface documents these side effects. Preserve the bit accumulation and explicit side-effect comments when changing this API. The attribute name operation does not imply an assignment that replaces all old flags.
title: Document offline-operation setters that also add operation bits
